text: Long Live Trump 💕Long Live Pahlavi💥Down 👎With 🥷Moullah 💣Khamenei 🫵Terrorist We, the Iranian people, no longer want an Islamic occupying government. All the leaders of the Iranian government were born in Iraq and have occupied the country of Iran for 47 years. These Iraqis have taken the lives of millions of Iranians during these 47 years and have not stopped killing. We, the Iranian people, shout with one voice all over the world that we no longer want this Islamic regime and are trying with our lives to save our country from the hands of the aggressor and occupier. This effort of the Iranian people is not only to liberate Iran but also to save the whole world. We are trying for the future of the entire world. By losing our lives, we are preventing the formation of another North Korea. A North Korea that is 100% supportive of terrorists and crimes. Yes, if the Iranian government achieves nuclear power, no one will be able to stop their crimes in Iran and the whole world, and they will start blackmailing other countries with nuclear threats. They will even use their nuclear power to destroy other nations. So the struggle of the Iranian people benefits the whole world, and we ask the entire world to support the Iranian people in this struggle and to be our support so that we can overthrow this criminal Islamic government and make the world a safe place. We are looking for a world where terrorists do not repeat the crimes of October 7th. And all religions are kind to each other and respect each other's beliefs—a world of peace and tranquility.
